phrase: a Hand-Painted and Customised Apparel Brand
verdict: Yes, as a premium, made-to-order brand. The Quirky Naari from Mathura pitched hand-painted jackets, shoes and customised pieces on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Buyers pay well for one-of-a-kind pieces, but every order takes skilled hands, so growth depends on training painters and pricing for your time.
angle: Hand-painted and personalised clothing sells to gift buyers, brides and anyone who wants something nobody else has. Because each piece is made to order, you carry almost no stock. The limit is time: price for the hours involved and build a small team of artists before taking on bulk orders.
